cards.title: Top-Down
cards.description: Looking straight down at the world.

cards.title: Three-Quarter
cards.description: Top-down, tilted so you see fronts and roofs.

cards.title: Isometric
cards.description: Angled grid view, like a little diorama.

cards.title: Side View
cards.description: Flat profile, left to right.

cards.title: Side View with Lanes
cards.description: Side-on, but you can step between depth lanes.

cards.title: First Person
cards.description: Through the character's own eyes.

cards.title: Over the Shoulder
cards.description: Close third person, camera behind them.

cards.title: Wide Third Person
cards.description: Camera pulled back to show the space around.

cards.title: Fixed Diorama
cards.description: One still camera per room, like a stage set.

cards.title: Free Orbit
cards.description: Spin the camera around the scene.

cards.title: Flip Screen
cards.description: Each screen is a room; walk off the edge to the next.

cards.title: Bird's-Eye Map
cards.description: Zoomed far out over a whole map.

cards.title: Cockpit
cards.description: Seated inside a vehicle, looking out.

cards.title: Auto-Scroll
cards.description: The camera keeps moving and you keep up.

cards.title: Split Screen
cards.description: Two views at once, side by side.

cards.title: Through a Screen
cards.description: You see it all through a device in the world.

cards.title: Tabletop
cards.description: Looking down at pieces on a table.

cards.title: Tight Zoom
cards.description: Close in and claustrophobic; you see very little.

cards.title: Single Screen
cards.description: The whole game fits on one fixed screen.

cards.title: Vertical Scroll
cards.description: Top to bottom, climbing or falling.
